label: late-original b / <DEL> in long sequences starting with 1/p/2 (diffuse)
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.007% of steps). Fires only at the end of the original phase (t 5-9, mostly the last 1-2 original tokens) and on the <DEL> step, mostly in L=8-9 sequences; never in the copy phase or before t=4. Enriched for input b (49% of mass), first token 1 (64% of mass) or p/2, and sequences whose early tokens include x and f (e.g. top example 1 p x f f c b b <DEL>). It looks like a conjunction over the whole prefix that no simple predicate captures: the best predicate (late original b in a sequence starting with 1/p/2) reaches only dev F1 0.12, mass recall 0.41, and most b steps in such sequences stay silent. Adding prefix conditions (seen f, seen x) raised precision to about 0.3 but recall fell below 0.1. The largest activations sit on b / <DEL> in sequences starting with 1 p x f f or 1 ... f.
